stateOwner: one serial audio worker; PCM queue is private

invariants.bufferLease: one same-thread ReleaseBuffer for every successful nonzero GetBuffer
invariants.commit: consume PCM only after successful ReleaseBuffer
invariants.partialUnderrun: zero the tail and release the complete packet
invariants.endOfStream: request and release only the remaining media frames; wait for endpoint padding to reach zero, then stop and complete
invariants.pcmIdentity: sample rate, encoding, channel count, container bits, valid bits, block align, channel mask, and interleaving must match before a lease
invariants.reset: only while stopped or primed; increment generation
invariants.invalidation: increment generation and reject the old stream
